title: Wireless Security: the air as perimeter
description: From WEP to WPA3: the 4-way handshake, classic attacks (deauth, evil twin) and how a WiFi network is properly audited.

seguridad-wireless-t01-q01.prompt: Why does WEP break in minutes (the design weakness)?

seguridad-wireless-t01-q02.prompt: Which exchange establishes the session key in WPA2-Personal and is THE capture target in an audit?

seguridad-wireless-t01-q03.prompt: In WPA-Personal, which two pieces compose the material hashcat/aircrack need to crack the password offline?

seguridad-wireless-t01-q04.prompt: Which WPA3 mechanism killed offline handshake cracking, and what is the weakness that replaces it in weak configs?

2.title: Deauth and evil twin: attacking trust

seguridad-wireless-t02-q01.prompt: What does a deauthentication attack do and what does it exploit?

seguridad-wireless-t02-q03.prompt: Which WPA-Enterprise (802.1X) mechanism could have prevented evil twin credential capture and what does deploying it require?
